text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even without Hokko Tarumae, the race is
a huge
crowd-pleaser.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the race is over, a number of
Copano
Rickey's friends come running
over.
Rickeeey!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah! Is that...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That was a fantastic race! We were
cheering you
on like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! You looked so powerful
out there, I
feel like you really made a
name for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Kita, Dia! You two came to watch me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! That was some real fleet
footwork!
Today turned out to be a real
Rickey festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well? Do you feel the urge to break out
into song
right here on the racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you mean outside the winning
concert?! I
can't sing here! People don't
usually do that,
right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I dunno. I think they'd do it if they
had a little
enka spirit in them.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know I would if I ever get the chance!
Dad would
probably love it too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haha! Oh, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Kita really loves her dad,
doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I guess I sort of ran with a similar feeling
today,
though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Today is a special day for my own
dad.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's his birthday! ☆ And for this special
occasion, I
figured I could bloom on the
track, like a bouquet
of flowers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why Copano Rickey ran
with extra
force today.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, I ran as best as I could. It seems
like the
race generated the usual
excitement, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The force fields felt a little off. Feng
shui never
lies.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The qi in the direction of Kan wasn't
surging like
the rest.
choice_data_list: Can you tell what it is?
Can you tell what it is?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The direction north, where Tomakomai
is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Without Tarumae, the people of
Tomakomai
won't feel as much
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Please, Tarumae. Come back soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That evening...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, about my next race. Have
we set a
goal yet?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Guaranteed? Which is it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, in a race Tarumae is sure to enter.
Yeah, in the race Tarumae's definitely in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of the biggest races in June, at the
Oi
Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Teio Sho... You're right. There's no
way she
won't be entering.
choice_data_list: I think they'll be aiming for the Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This time, this race... We'll do it for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's fans are definitely
looking
forward to a showdown with
Hokko Tarumae. It's
the perfect chance
to demonstrate the power of
feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, I'll be taking on the Teio Sho.
And
surely...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Surely, you'll be doing the same. For a
chance to
compete with me once again!
